new.ends: Mixed site: MAX_WINDOWS+2 windows cross the retained-window count; no oversized canonical facts are tested. Classify count. Per-event window ceiling folds overflow restrictions into the top-level status. MAX_WINDOWS + 2 real input windows retain exactly MAX_WINDOWS and preserve the rejected/unknown restriction; temporary facts end with the event.

old.ends: Per-event window ceiling folds overflow restrictions into the top-level status. MAX_WINDOWS + 2 real input windows retain exactly MAX_WINDOWS and preserve the rejected/unknown restriction; temporary facts end with the event.

new.ends: Scalar batch validation; actual bounded SQL work is independently registered as nested page. One page at most 32 records; only maintenance, resumes after the page and skips readers/transactions. Not a run admission cap. SQL selection is limited to 2048 callbacks and 25 ms.

old.ends: One page at most 32 records; only maintenance, resumes after the page and skips readers/transactions. Not a run admission cap. SQL selection is limited to 2048 callbacks and 25 ms.

Every edge on a live or replayable custody path stays, without fixed/per-digest cap. No-live-custody paths are removed at owner open and maintenance. Bound: updates since oldest unreleased digest; unprotected rows <=64 (actually zero after a pass).

new.ends: At most 16 immutable lineage links per verification, not a lifetime record cap; longer or cyclic paths keep custody.

old.ends: At most 16 immutable lineage links per verification, not a lifetime record cap; longer or cyclic paths keep custody.

new.ends: Mixed site: two projects/two items refuse a third, drain, then admit; classify count rather than bytes. Pending items are removed by take_nowait; empty projects leave the fair queue. Two projects of two items reject an extra item and a third project, then drain and admit fresh work.

old.ends: Pending items are removed by take_nowait; empty projects leave the fair queue. Two projects of two items reject an extra item and a third project, then drain and admit fresh work.

new.ends: the attempt count belongs to one sweep pass and resets on the next; the cursor advances on refusals and errors so later runs still get recorded

old.ends: the attempt count belongs to one sweep pass and resets on the next; the cursor advances on refusals and errors so later runs still get recorded

new.ends: O0c M8: a job ends when its worker confirms it stopped; one whose execution is unconfirmed faults the signature lane, and the account's self-restart (H1c) ends it once every child is proven gone

old.ends: O0c M8: a job ends when its worker confirms it stopped; one whose execution is unconfirmed faults the signature lane, and the account's self-restart (H1c) ends it once every child is proven gone

new.ends: Mixed site: 1070 launch rows are bounded to MAX_TAKEOVER_RUNS=64; classify demonstrated run count rather than bytes. Complete widest serialized journal <=16384 bytes; excess unsettled runs are counted durably, never dropped from totals.

old.ends: Complete widest serialized journal <=16384 bytes; excess unsettled runs are counted durably, never dropped from totals.

new.ends: A1: fixed integer, version, path, authorization and at-most-64 listed-run widths; one journal ends at completion or pre-stop undo.

old.ends: A1: fixed integer, version, path, authorization and at-most-64 listed-run widths; one journal ends at completion or pre-stop undo.

new.ends: Conservative widest-document construction is a serialization precondition used by reconcile; widest itself has no quota comparison or retained population. Reserves all future fields at 2^63-1 before selecting runs; at most 64 copied rows per takeover.

old.ends: Reserves all future fields at 2^63-1 before selecting runs; at most 64 copied rows per takeover.

new.ends: Bounded intent bytes, not a lifetime run count; no replacement is made when it cannot fit.

old.ends: Bounded intent bytes, not a lifetime run count; no replacement is made when it cannot fit.

new.ends: A single scope-endpoint connect waits at most 0.2 seconds. An unreadable or timed-out endpoint remains live; only ENOENT/ECONNREFUSED proves it no longer answers. The enclosing stop deadline ends the loop.

old.ends: A single scope-endpoint connect waits at most 0.2 seconds. An unreadable or timed-out endpoint remains live; only ENOENT/ECONNREFUSED proves it no longer answers. The enclosing stop deadline ends the loop.

new.ends: Read-only registry/status aggregation COUNT and schema-version compatibility; never compares a child population with a ceiling. The old CLI-message-only binding was wrong. COUNT(*) is a read-only diagnostic of live, unreleased child slots. It imposes no limit and refuses no update; normal authenticated settlement or crash grace ends each slot.

old.ends: COUNT(*) is a read-only diagnostic of live, unreleased child slots. It imposes no limit and refuses no update; normal authenticated settlement or crash grace ends each slot.

new.ends: Five seconds for a starting service to publish a hint or release history/host flocks; absent service then project_store_busy. Authorization read remains capped at 1 KiB.

old.ends: Five seconds for a starting service to publish a hint or release history/host flocks; absent service then project_store_busy. Authorization read remains capped at 1 KiB.

new.ends: Both birth fallback and kqueue waits end at their passed deadline (30 seconds TERM / 5 seconds KILL). NOTE_EXEC is retained for I4 and never mistaken for exit or timeout.

old.ends: Both birth fallback and kqueue waits end at their passed deadline (30 seconds TERM / 5 seconds KILL). NOTE_EXEC is retained for I4 and never mistaken for exit or timeout.

new.ends: At most three stop/probe rounds after the start barrier; an inherited lock leaves a resumable failure, never adoption.

old.ends: At most three stop/probe rounds after the start barrier; an inherited lock leaves a resumable failure, never adoption.
